_description: Vision flags a bore diameter of 10.071 mm on B-4471 (spec 10.00 ± 0.05) — a safety-critical medical-device batch: intake's hard-stop forces quarantine + max severity, the engineer traces it to the out-of-spec titanium lot and drafts a CAPA, and the finisher routes the batch to the QA Manager. A QA Manager release is only the first signature; the Quality Director signs second.
